title: ‘Wh’ questions (Theme 13: Savings)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child chooses the word for the answer wanted, swaps the helping verb before the subject, and ends with a question mark.

floor.prerequisite: Asks what, where, when, who questions.
floor.question: Ask where Ali lives.

steps: Show answers; ask which word gets them.
Swap the verb: you are, are you.

board.do: Write: ___ did you travel? By bus.

board.say: Which word fits? Why or How?

board.do: Wait for the child to choose.
The child writes the word in the gap.

listen_for: How did you save the money.

checks.question: Put in order: late / you / why / are
___ did you call? I called my aunt.
